title: Non-UDG Treated Double-Stranded Ancient DNA Library Preparation for Illumina Sequencing
author: Franziska Aron
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bakricv6

steps.title: Prepare Blunt End Repair Mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare a blunt end repair mastermix calculating 50 µL per reaction in a new 1.5 ml LoBind tube.

steps.title: Incubate Blunt End Repair
steps.instruction: Incubate the reactions in a thermocycler at 25 °C for 00:20:00, then at 12 °C for 00:10:00.

substeps.instruction: Warm MinElute tubes to room temperature during incubation.
Label two sets of 1.5 ml LoBind tubes per sample and one set of 0.2 ml PCR tubes.
Optionally add 650 µL PB-Buffer to one set of 1.5 ml LoBind tubes for the subsequent purification step.

steps.title: Purify Blunt-End Repaired DNA
steps.instruction: Purify the blunt-end repaired DNA using a MinElute kit with the following modified steps:

substeps.instruction: Add 650 µL PB (binding) buffer to a new 1.5 ml LoBind tube and add the blunt end repaired sample; vortex briefly to mix.
Load the mixture onto a MinElute column and incubate at RT for 00:02:00.
Spin at 15800 x g for 1 minute and discard flow-through (remove liquid with pipette or pour into waste tube; clean surface with water then bleach/DNA Away).
Add 700 µL PE (wash) buffer to the column.
Spin at 15800 x g for 1 minute and discard flow-through.
Dry spin at 15800 x g for 1 minute.
Flip columns 180° and dry spin again at 15800 x g for 1 minute.
Remove columns and place them in new 1.5 ml LoBind tubes.
Add 20 µL pre-heated EBT to the center of the membrane, let stand for 00:01:00, then spin at 15800 x g for 1 minute to elute.

steps.title: Prepare Adapter Ligation Mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare an adapter ligation mastermix calculating 40 µL per reaction in a 1.5 ml LoBind tube.

substeps.instruction: Note: The mastermix is designed for the individual addition of Quick Ligase after aliquotting to reaction tubes.

steps.title: Ligate Adapters
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of Quick ligase (5 U stock, 0.125 U final concentration) to each library sample.

substeps.instruction: Mix by flicking and spin down, ensuring the full volume of ligase is recovered from the pipette tip by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at 22 °C for 00:20:00 in the thermocycler.
During incubation, warm MinElute tubes to room temperature.
Label two sets of 1.5 ml LoBind tubes and 0.2 ml PCR tubes per sample.
Optionally add 650 µL PB-Buffer to one set of 1.5 ml LoBind tubes for the subsequent purification step.

steps.title: Purify Adapter-Ligated Libraries
steps.instruction: Purify the adapter-ligated libraries using a MinElute kit with the following modified steps:

substeps.instruction: Add 650 µL PB buffer to a new 1.5 ml LoBind tube and add the entire volume of the adapter ligation mix; vortex briefly.
Load the mixture onto a MinElute column and incubate for 00:02:00.
Spin at 15800 x g for 1 minute and discard flow-through.
Add 700 µL PE buffer to the column.
Spin at 15800 x g for 1 minute and discard flow-through.
Dry spin at 15800 x g for 1 minute.
Flip columns 180° and dry spin again at 15800 x g for 1 minute.
Remove columns and place them in new 1.5 ml LoBind tubes.
Add 22 µL of pre-heated EBT to the center of the membrane, let stand for 00:01:00, then spin at 15800 x g for 1 minute to elute.

steps.title: Perform Adapter Fill-In
steps.instruction: Prepare an adapter fill-in reaction calculating 40 µL per reaction in a 1.5 ml LoBind tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL mastermix to each reaction tube and add 10 µL sample DNA (using 0.2 ml PCR tube strips). Mix by flicking and spin down briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:30:00, then at 80 °C for 00:10:00 in the thermocycler.
During incubation, label new 0.2 ml tubes for step 10 and new 1.5 ml LoBind tubes for step 11.

steps.title: Final Library Storage
steps.instruction: Transfer the remaining ~36 µL of final library to a fresh 1.5 ml LoBind tube.

substeps.instruction: Freeze the library at -20 °C without purification until further processing.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Quality Check
steps.instruction: Prepare a qPCR assay calculating 20 µL per reaction (2 reactions per sample, plus 16 reactions for 7 standards in duplicate and 2 blanks).

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1:10 dilutions of the libraries in the cleanroom by aliquotting 18 µL water to 0.2 ml PCR tubes and adding 2 µL per library.
In the modern lab, add 19 µL mastermix and 1 µL of the 1:10 diluted libraries, standards, or water to a fresh 96-well qPCR plate.
Seal with adhesive clear qPCR seal sheets and spin down; ensure no bubbles are present (centrifuge at max speed if necessary).
Important: Do NOT vortex DyNAmo MasterMix; gently pipette or invert to mix to avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Amplify qPCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the qPCR reactions using the specified program to determine the number of DNA copies for indexing input.

steps.title: Additional Eluate Processing
steps.instruction: Process additional eluates as required for the protocol.

substeps.instruction: For the adapter fill-in step: Add 20 µL of mastermix and the complete eluate from step 7.10 (~20 µL) to 0.2 ml PCR strips; mix by flicking and spin down.
For the blunt-end repair eluate: Aliquot 21 µL of mastermix to 0.2 ml PCR strips and transfer the complete eluate from step 3.10 (~18 µL) per sample to each tube.
